description:
Select all populated places (cities) that fall within African countries and export them to a new shapefile.

1. Open the existing project '/home/ga/gvsig_data/projects/countries_base.gvsproj' which contains the world countries layer ('ne_110m_admin_0_countries').
2. Add the populated places layer: '/home/ga/gvsig_data/cities/ne_110m_populated_places.shp'.
3. Select all African countries (where CONTINENT = 'Africa') in the countries layer.
4. Use a spatial selection tool (e.g., 'Select by Layer') to select all cities from 'ne_110m_populated_places' that are contained within or intersect the selected African countries.
5. Export the selected cities to a new shapefile named 'african_cities.shp' in the folder '/home/ga/gvsig_data/exports/'.

The final shapefile should contain only African cities (~30-40 features).
